what: Signal helper under set -euo pipefail lacks kill failure guards
scenario_or_breakage: kill -TERM/-KILL or kill -0 on a stale/dead PID returns non-zero and aborts the monitor before exit 4 leaving the background Family B process orphaned and the orchestrator without the intended timeout contract
suggested_fix: Wrap larch_bm_signal_paired_pid kill/poll calls with || true (or local set +e) and always fall through to exit 4; add harness case for ESRCH/stale PID
